scheme_name: Financial Assistance to ST Students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
other_conditions: Student must be a regular full-time student studying in a recognized institution or university.
Applicant should have availed or be eligible for the Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship during the current academic year.
Student must not be repeating a class; cannot receive the scholarship again for the same class.
benefits_summary: Additional maintenance allowance of ₹7,500 for day scholars or ₹15,000 for hostellers for a period of 10 months.
